question: Which of the following is **NOT** a conventional source of energy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Windmill**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Energy:**

 
 
• **It** is the** basic and universal measure** for all kinds of work by nature and human beings. Every activity in nature has a flow of energy.
 
• Energy can be categorized into two types
 
 
• **Conventional**
 
• **Non-conventional**
 
 
 
• **Non-conventional source of energy**
 
 
• It is renewable energy that is **used by human beings** for a long time.
 
• This type of energy is **continuously produced** in nature and is **inexhaustible**.
 
• Non-conventional sources of energy include solar energy, wind, and biomass.
 
• These sources **do not produce any pollution** in the environment.
 
• **Examples are Wood, Solar energy, wind energy, hydropower, tidal energy, geothermal energy, Biomass Energy, etc. Hence, Option 1 is correct.**
 
 
 
• **A** **conventional source **of energy
 
 
• It is a **natural resource that is available in nature **and is available in **limited quantities**.
 
• They are also known as a **non-renewable source** of energy as once depleted, they** cannot be re-generated easily.**
 
• They are formed from decay matter over hundreds and millions of years. 
 
• **Examples are Oil, Coal, petroleum, natural gas, nuclear fuels, hydel power, etc.**
